# vehicleCollateral - Confirmation of Required Values

_Category: Report an Issue · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**chelsea.hansen** (4/7/2022):

On the API Spec for vehicleCollateral, the serialNumber, year, make and model do not show as being required, however on the BC PPR UI the year is currently the only optional value.

Can confirmation be made on if these values are going to be made optional or if they will remain required?

---

**Melissa** (4/8/2022):

The API spec is based on the legacy data; the UI requirements are for new vehicle collateral. The UI will not change, the spec vehicle collateral description should be updated to align with the UI. 

Ticket 11821 has been logged for this update.
